format: Newest first. Bump this file to ship an update: the first version here is built and published as mac-vX.Y.Z.

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Word timing now counts the syllables in every word (silent e, -ing, -ed, contractions like couldn't, and odd words like everyone) and looks for each syllable's start in the singing.

Stutters and repeats like "eh eh everyone", "la la la" and "I I I can't stop" are timed one by one: repeated words are expected to be quick, and when too few syllable starts show up, Strata looks again more closely.
The last note of a line is allowed to be held a little longer.
Words still stay inside their own line's time from the lyrics file.

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Word timing now follows the lyrics' own line times: a line never starts before its time or runs into the next line, so words can't get mixed up between lines. The singing only decides where each word falls inside its line.
First words no longer light up early (a breath, an ad-lib or the end of the line before can't start a line any more).
A (bracketed ad-lib) line sung over a line no longer cuts that line short in the timing.
Songs timed with 2.8.0 are re-timed the next time they play.

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Fixes the lag from 2.6 and 2.7: word timing no longer uses a big downloaded model. It is replaced by a small home-made voice finder that runs on one core for a couple of seconds per song, with nothing to download. The old model is deleted automatically.

The voice finder keeps the centred, steady part of the song (the singing), finds where each syllable starts, and lines every word up with it. Lines are timed to the real singing, so ad-libs don't rush or cut a line. Works best when the vocals are in the middle of the mix.
Word timing is on by default (Settings > General > Word timing). Karaoke features all work with it: word-by-word lighting, two lit lines, the filling dots and the lyric wheel.
Strata Music for Mac works on macOS 13 again.

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Lyrics: at the start and end of a song, and in long instrumental breaks, three dots appear and fill up one by one as the next line gets closer.

Two lines can now be lit at once, so an ad-lib sung over the end of a line no longer cuts that line short. Bracketed ad-libs like (yeah) no longer make the line before them rush; with precise word timing the overlap follows the voice exactly.

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Precise word timing is much faster: it uses all the fast cores, listens to several pieces of the song at once, skips the parts with no lyrics, keeps the model loaded between songs and remembers what it heard, so syncing a song again is instant.

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Precise word timing: Strata can now listen to a song with Meta's MMS forced-alignment model (int8, ONNX) and time every word, so the lit word follows the voice. Turn it on in Settings > General > Precise word timing (a one-time download of about 356 MB), or use Sync words precisely in the lyrics menu.
Results are saved as an enhanced .lrc (a time before each word), which older Strata versions can read. Original timing is one click away.
Strata Music for Mac now needs macOS 14 or later (the word-timing engine, ONNX Runtime, requires it).

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Full-screen player: the album cover now sits on the left, centred top to bottom in the window, with the song info and controls beside it.
The close button sits the same distance from the top as from the left edge in full screen (it still clears the title bar in a window).

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Lyrics: the word being sung fills in left to right at the speed it is sung and is a little bigger. The highlight follows the player's clock smoothly instead of in steps
Lyrics without word timings get better guesses: words are timed by syllables, with pauses at commas and full stops, and a line followed by a long pause no longer stretches across it
The lines that aren't being sung sit on a gentle curve to the left, like a wheel. They get smaller, dimmer and turn away a little, and the wheel turns with a bounce when the line changes
Lyric files are unchanged, so they still work in other Strata versions (word-timed .lrc files give exact timing; others use the new guess)

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Songs no longer start loud and then drop: the volume level is worked out before a song starts (and for the next one ahead of time), and the enhanced engine now gets it too
No window toolbar any more, so there is no separate top bar in full screen either: the title, search, layout switch, sidebar and back buttons sit right on the page
Artist and album pages have a soft background taken from the cover

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Artist banners: pictures that failed to load are now retried from another address, and artists with no Wikipedia photo get one from Deezer. Until a photo loads (or if none does) the banner shows a soft copy of the artist's cover

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: The top bar is gone: the window's background now runs all the way up, with the search box and the + button floating on it
Scroll bars only appear while you scroll, whatever your Mac's setting says

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: The Settings tab inside the app is gone; settings are in the Strata Music menu (Settings…, ⌘,)

Lighter again: dragging the volume slider no longer redraws the rest of the app, the sidebar and Downloads row update on their own while downloads run, YouTube pictures are downloaded once and shrunk to the size they're shown at, album cards only draw a shadow while you point at them, and the play history is saved in the background

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Much lighter: the whole window no longer redraws on every download progress tick, lyrics only redraw the line being sung, searching no longer stalls while you type, backgrounds use a pre-blurred picture instead of blurring the window every frame, and animations pause when the window can't be seen
Volume levelling: songs are measured once and played at a common level (Settings › Playback)
A visualizer in the full player (bars or mirrored), drawn from each song's measured spectrum
Output device picker: choose the speakers or headphones from the player or from Settings › Playback
Choose the order of the player's pages, a list layout for songs (and a table/list switch in the toolbar), and Dock icon colours
strata:// links so Shortcuts, Raycast and scripts can play, pause, skip, like and start playlists (Settings › Advanced). Real Siri and widget support still needs an Xcode project

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Drag songs onto a playlist in the sidebar to add them; drop them on New Playlist to start one
Drag a single song out of the app and it is the real file: drop it on the desktop, a folder, or a web page's upload box
Drag several songs, an album or a playlist out and it becomes a music pack: when you let go, a window asks for the title and the audio format, then makes one .zip with the songs and a pack.json
Dropping songs that came from the app back onto its own window no longer re-imports them

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Fixes the freeze that happened when you switched back to the app or did something: saving, sorting, grouping albums and artists, and decoding covers no longer run on the thread that draws the window, and animations pause while the app is in the background

The Downloads item in the sidebar now shows a download symbol with how many are in progress and a tick with how many are done (0 is shown too); the page keeps its text and also lists what has been downloaded
Discord Rich Presence is on by default, with a status line and a Test button in Settings › Discord
Smoother pages (a short fade), a lighter player background, and a stall log in Diagnostics that records how long any freeze lasted

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Sync between your devices: pick a folder that iCloud Drive, Dropbox or Syncthing already shares, and likes, playlists and play counts are merged through it. No server
Newest like or unlike wins, playlists merge by name (a deleted playlist stays deleted), and play counts never go backwards
Settings has new tabs: Look, Sync and Advanced

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Test YouTube (Settings > Advanced): checks opening the page, searching, finding the audio and downloading a few bytes, and says which step fails
The YouTube page resets itself after three failures in a row, for search as well as downloads, and there's an engine log you can copy
If Strata Music didn't close properly last time, it offers to save a diagnostics file with the log and the newest crash report
Unit tests for lyrics parsing, version order, seasons and more now run on every build

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: A new Look tab in Settings: accent colour from the cover or one you pick, and a player background of aurora, blurred cover, moving gradient or plain
Glass: how much colour the media bar has and how round its corners are
Player: which page it opens on, cover size, shape (rounded, square, circle) and shadow, and which buttons show
Media bar: a compact version, and the like and Up Next buttons can be hidden; cover size in lists
Seasons: Autumn leaves, Winter snow, Spring petals, Off, or Automatic by date. Always behind the text

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Lyrics light up word by word (uses word timings when a file has them, otherwise they're spread across the line)
Fix the sync for one song (earlier or later, saved), import your own .lrc or plain lyrics, or mark a song as having no lyrics
Hide bad words, show non-Latin lyrics in Latin letters, and translate lyrics on macOS 15 and later
Share lyrics: pick up to six lines and save or copy a picture in the cover's colours
The current lyric shows in the menu bar player, and Desktop Lyrics (⌥⌘D) floats a strip over your other windows

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Menu bar player: cover, seek bar, transport, like and Up Next from the top of your screen (can be turned off in Settings)
Mini player: a small floating window that resizes from a thin strip up to a square cover. Toggle it with ⌥⌘M
Dock menu with play/pause, next, previous and like; optional notification when the song changes
Keyboard: ⌘L likes, ⌘U opens Up Next, ⌘J shows the current song's album, ⌥⌘←/→ skip 10 seconds, ⌘/ lists every shortcut (Lyrics moved to ⌥⌘L)
The green full screen button now opens the player

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: A Home page: jump back in, made-for-you mixes, your artists, albums you haven't played in a while, and new releases from your artists
Radio: start it from any song, album or artist. Songs you own play right away, the rest download just ahead of time, and Up Next marks them
Replay: your top songs, artists and minutes for this month, last month, this year or all time, with a picture you can save or copy
Artist pages with a big photo, a short bio, your top songs, and albums split from singles
Search shows YouTube Music results under your own songs as you type. Arrow keys move through the list and Return opens it

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Edit Info: change title, artist, album, year and cover (from a file, the clipboard or online) and look up song info; it is written into M4A files too
Smart Playlists with your own rules, plus Most Played, Recently Played and Never Played
Playlists: duplicate, export and import M3U, bring your playlists, play counts and favorites over from the Music app
Your music folders are watched, so new and deleted songs appear by themselves; a Duplicates page; Find Missing Covers

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Opus and Ogg songs (Android music packs, .opus exports) now play and show their tags and covers on the Mac
A new Enhanced playback engine (Settings > Playback): gapless playback, crossfade, a 10-band equaliser with presets, and playback speed. Standard stays the default
AirPlay / output picker and a speed menu in the player
Play counts are tracked (a Plays column in the song list)

releases.name: The Macster Update
notes: Download everything by an artist: on a YouTube artist page or the artist's search result. It reads all their releases, tells you how many songs it found (leaving out what you already have) and asks before downloading
Settings now opens inside the window (sidebar > Settings) and the sidebar button works
The leaves fall behind the text and buttons, and still carry on smoothly when the player opens
Esc closes the full-screen player; the close button is bigger and no longer fights the title bar; drag the top of the player down to close it
The media bar fades out and slides up as the player opens, and back when it closes
Polish: no extra pill on the search box, hover play buttons on albums, dancing bars on the playing song, a heart in the media bar, the window and last song are remembered

releases.name: The Thanksgiving Update
notes: YouTube downloading: search YouTube Music (songs, albums, playlists, artists) or paste a link, then download. Songs are saved as tagged M4A files with their cover and appear in your library
A Downloads page with progress and speed, and a Downloads tab in Settings (folder, how many at once). Settings is also in the sidebar now
Search: click the search box and the page dims and a list of matches drops down as you type, with a 'Not showing up? Search the web' button on top that looks it up on YouTube
The falling leaves are one layer for the whole window, so opening the player no longer restarts or speeds them up
The full-screen player hides the sidebar button and the window title
New: Up Next queue, sleep timer, Recently Added, Go to Album / Go to Artist, and Command-F for search

releases.name: The Thanksgiving Update
notes: Updates now happen inside the app: a small window asks "Update available" with Nah, I'm good and Yes, of course, then downloads, replaces the app and reopens it
The app checks when it opens and every few hours, and there is a Check for Updates… item in the Strata Music menu

releases.name: The Thanksgiving Update
notes: The app and the disk image now use the real Strata Music icon
A new installer window: small, big icons, a custom background and an arrow to Applications
Ready for Apple notarization: with a Developer ID the app opens with no warning at all

releases.name: The Thanksgiving Update
notes: Strata Music for Mac: the Android app's look mixed with Apple Music's layout. Liquid Glass on macOS 26 and later, blurred glass on earlier versions
Songs, Albums, Artists, Favorites and Playlists; add folders or drop songs on the window
A full-screen player with three pages (Lyrics, Current Song, Artist) and a glass pill to switch them, with falling brown, yellow and red leaves
Synced lyrics from LRCLIB, or an .lrc file next to the song
Discord Rich Presence with the album cover, over the Discord app on your Mac (no sign-in)
Export a song as M4A, ALAC, FLAC, WAV or AIFF; media keys and Control Centre work
Update check against GitHub releases
